recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-14750 unless a separate issue addresses unrelated editorial wording nearby.

reconciliation: No source files were changed because the current active XML already uses preservation in the requested places and a resource-scoped search found no remaining conservation wording in SpecimenDefinition.
